channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Lamar Odom | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Lamar Odom from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Elton Brand on Lamar Odom, Steve Francis
item.description:
Brand told The Undefeated.

“If you see the No. 3 pick getting off, it’s like, ‘I need to get mine.’ I went through that with Steve Francis and Lamar Odom. Steve would have 25 points and 15 assists and Lamar would have a triple-double. And I’m looking at the pressure like, ‘Now, I got to do something all day long.’ What I learned is that you don’t get too high if you have a good game and you don’t get too low if you had a bad game.”

Elton Brand on Lamar Odom, Steve Francis, Jul 4, 2017. Source: The Undefeated.

item.title: Byron Scott on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Byron Scott on Lamar Odom:

“His recovery has been a miracle & we just continue to wish him nothing but the best.”

Byron Scott on Lamar Odom, Mar 31, 2016. Source: Twitter @Lakers_Examiner.

item.title: Byron Scott on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Byron Scott on Lamar Odom:

“It is absolutely fantastic to see where he is now from the stories we were getting a few months ago.”

Byron Scott on Lamar Odom, Mar 31, 2016. Source: Twitter @Lakers_Examiner.

item.title: Ben Simmons on LeBron James, Lamar Odom
item.description:
NBA scout on LSU frosh Ben Simmons:

“Magic/LeBron comparisons a bit much; game will be more like Lamar Odom at next level. I'd take that.”

Ben Simmons on LeBron James, Lamar Odom, Dec 3, 2015. Source: Twitter @AmicoHoops.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Blake Griffin on seeing Lamar Odom:

“Hopefully he knows there’s a lot of guys that love him and want to see him do better.”

Blake Griffin on Lamar Odom, Oct 17, 2015. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Gentry recalled Wednesday at Pelicans training camp.

“He said, ‘I want to apologize because I feel like I am as responsible as anybody for getting you fired because I didn’t play the way I supposed to and I didn’t do what I was supposed to.’ I been in the league 27 years, and that’s happened once, OK? And it was Lamar Odom who did it.”

Alvin Gentry on Lamar Odom, Oct 15, 2015. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Charlie Villanueva on Lamar Odom
item.description:
#Mavs FCharlie Villanueva on fellow Queens, N.Y. product Lamar Odom:

“One of the realist persons I've ever gotten a chance to be around. It's just very tragic. He come and took me under his wing when I was in high school.”

Charlie Villanueva on Lamar Odom, Oct 15, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Chris Bosh on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Chris Bosh on Lamar Odom:

“He was one of my heroes to me when he was in college.”

Chris Bosh on Lamar Odom, Oct 15, 2015. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Dirk Nowitzki:

“It's just an incredibly sad story. I think (Lamar Odom) was a great guy, even though stuff didn't work out for him here. I've got nothing but positive and nice things to say about him. He was always cool to us -- his teammates. Sometimes, he was just a little frustrated because it wasn't going his way, but (Lamar Odom) was a fun guy to be around. It's just a sad story, and we all obviously wish (Lamar Odom) well. We're thinking about him. Hopefully he'll pull through.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Lamar Odom, Oct 15, 2015. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle on Lamar Odom:

“It's a very distressing situation. We know he's fighting for his life, and wish him the best.”

Rick Carlisle on Lamar Odom, Oct 15, 2015. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Carmelo on Lamar Odom:

“He was one the best players I had ever seen coming out of high school.”

Carmelo Anthony on Lamar Odom, Oct 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @FisolaNYDN.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Steve Popper:Carmelo on Odom's life in public:

“That’s a tough situation to be in. It works for some people and it don’t work for others. So I think you just have to come down to the individual and know how to manage that and put priorities in place.”

Carmelo Anthony on Lamar Odom, Oct 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @StevePopper.

item.title: Caron Butler on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Jason Jones:Caron Butler on Lamar Odom:

“Extremely saddened by that news. I got a text from a mutual friend and I'm praying for him right now.”

Caron Butler on Lamar Odom, Oct 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @mr_jasonjones.

item.title: Sasha Vujacic on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Steve Popper:Sasha Vujacic on Odom:

“I think he will win this battle. He’s a guy with a heart of gold.”

Sasha Vujacic on Lamar Odom, Oct 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @StevePopper.

item.title: Metta World Peace on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Dan Duggan:World Peace on childhood friend Lamar Odom:

“It’s shocking headlines, but I need to speak to him. I have not spoken to him in a long time.”

Metta World Peace on Lamar Odom, Sep 18, 2013. Source: Twitter @DDuggan21.

item.title: Jordan Farmar on Lamar Odom
item.description:
“We're all here for him, really. We know what kind of guy he really is. Everybody goes through tough times in life, and if he needs anybody, he can always reach out to us.”

Jordan Farmar on Lamar Odom, Sep 4, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Lamar Odom
item.description:
The previous day, Lakers legend Magic Johnson tweeted,

“I hope my man and former Laker, Lamar Odom is doing okay.”

Magic Johnson on Lamar Odom, Aug 31, 2013. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Chris Kaman on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Dwain Price:Chris Kaman on Lamar Odom:

“He’s been overweight and out of shape. I think you’ve seen what he can do when he’s in great shape and healthy.”

Chris Kaman on Lamar Odom, Dec 5, 2012. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Lamar Odom
item.description:
“One of the things about (Lamar) Odom’s contract is it is a contract that is going to be very desirable because it is a large number with a small guarantee, like (Jerry) Stackhouse’s and like (Erick) Dampier’s deal,”

Rick Carlisle on Lamar Odom, May 17, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Dirk on the Odom trade:

“I don't even know what [a trade exception] is, but we turned nothing into a great player.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Lamar Odom, Dec 11, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Lamar Odom
item.description:
Mike Bresnahan:Kobe on Odom trade:

“I don't like it. He's great at bringing guys together. I trust management knows what they're doing...but it's tough.”

Kobe Bryant on Lamar Odom, Dec 11, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Kobe Bryant, Lamar Odom
item.description:
Mavericks coach Rick Carlisle said.

“As great as Kobe Bryant is, and he is unguardable, Odom is right there with him as one of the most difficult matchups in all of basketball. We needed Peja’s shooting out there, but the job he did defensively was equally important.”

Rick Carlisle on Kobe Bryant, Lamar Odom, May 7, 2011. Source: Dallas Morning News.
